thread:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — a handful of multi-GPU training jobs in ap-southeast-2 are hitting NCCL stalls + huge tail latency on allreduce. Seen this across two different clusters.
Sahil Kapoor: Report any logs? NCCL_DEBUG=INFO?
Maria Chen: Pasting the short output. Jobs pick up then everything blocks at iteration ~1200.
Maria Chen: ```
NCCL INFO Transport/Plugin : ib
NCCL INFO Using ibverbs GID index 0
NCCL ERROR AllReduce : timeout, rank 0 waiting at barrier
``` 
Maria Chen: infra-bot posted an alert for packet reordering on mlx5 ports around the same time :eyes:
infra-bot: alert: High RDMA packet reordering detected on fabric-ap2-tor-07 (port 2/3) — counter rx_reorder=4523, tx_reorder=0
Isaac Ng: rx_reorder counters that high usually mean out-of-order ECMP forwarding between ToRs or a bad inline LAG. Any recent switch upgrades?
Maria Chen: Switch team did a rolling firmware bump two nights ago on ap2-tor-0[6-9]. Suspect correlation.
Sahil Kapoor: Can you dump ethtool/ib counters from one affected host? Also ibv_devinfo + perfquery for the HCA.
Maria Chen: Ran these on host gpu-aps2-142:
Maria Chen: ```
$ ibv_devinfo -v
hca_id: mlx5_0
fw_ver: 16.26.1040
port 1:
  state: ACTIVE (4)
$ ethtool -S eth0 | grep reorder
rx_reorder_pkts: 4132
tx_reorder_pkts: 0
$ sudo perfquery -D | grep -i reorder
rx_reordered: 4132
``` 
Jen Ortiz: That asymmetric rx-only reorder spike smells like ingress path change — packets coming back on a different path than they left.
Isaac Ng: Agreed. RDMA is sensitive to reordering; NIC/driver tries to recover but large reorders kill NCCL ring protocols.
Sahil Kapoor: Quick mitigation: disable ECMP hashing to force single path for the pod-vlan and see if NCCL stabilizes. Can you test with one job pinned to a single subnet/ToR?
Maria Chen: Spun up a test job pinned to rack 07 only (single ToR) — after pinning, no stalls for 30 minutes. Reordering counters dropped to ~0.
Maria Chen: So isolate to cross-tor traffic.
infra-bot: note: change_logged switchfabric/ap2-tor-07 firmware 7 -> 8 at 2025-11-12T03:14Z
Jen Ortiz: Follow-ups: collect pcap from the ToR and the NIC to show sequence numbers. Also check switch flow table for hash seed changes on that firmware.
Sahil Kapoor: Commands I used historically:
Sahil Kapoor: ```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/ib_pkt.pcap 'ether proto 0x8915'
# ib verbs specific counters
sudo ethtool -S eth0 | egrep 'reorder|rx_err|rx_mcast'
# check MLS/EQ stats on the switch (ask network team)
```
Maria Chen: I'll pull pcaps. Quick note: Not all jobs cross ToR — only bigger placements that span multiple racks.
Isaac Ng: Is there any confounder like LACP being misconfigured causing asymmetric hashing? Or ECMP symmetry broken by weight heuristics.
Jen Ortiz: I opened a ticket with the switch vendor (case 992-AP2) and added logs + pcap. Vendor suspect a firmware regression in ECMP flow hashing when combined with our Spine balancer config.
Sahil Kapoor: Short-term mitigations:
- pin multi-GPU jobs to single ToR (affects scheduling/capacity)
- enforce single path for RDMA traffic via static routes or infra ACLs
- rollback switch firmware if vendor confirms regression
Maria Chen: We applied a scheduling label to avoid cross-tor placements for large NCCL jobs and queued an emergency rollback window tonight.
Maria Chen: After label applied, 6/6 jobs that previously failed now steady.
Isaac Ng: Eventually we should add NCCL-aware binpacking to avoid cross-tor placements by default for >1 GPU jobs.
Jen Ortiz: Filed infra ticket INFRA-4378 to track: symptoms, ccap, vendor case, temporary scheduler label, rollback plan, and follow-up forensic steps.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. Will keep thread updated after vendor reply and post-pcap analysis.
Sahil Kapoor: If vendor says it's not firmware, also verify MLX5 kernel driver ABI mismatch across hosts (make sure all nodes have same mlx5_core version + firmware). Small chance of HCA sending reorders.
Maria Chen: noted. grabbing driver versions next.
infra-bot: reminder: rolling rollback window scheduled 2025-11-13 01:00 UTC — assigned Jen Ortiz :white_check_mark:
Jen Ortiz: I'll coordinate with network to run rollback and run a small burn test after.
Maria Chen: :thumbsup:"
